style.prompt: Create a polished square social media promotional graphic announcing a sale. Typography-first contemporary editorial design, warm ivory background, bold cobalt blue typography with vibrant orange accents, crisp high contrast, balanced generous margins. Main headline in huge beautifully arranged perfectly legible sans serif type: "20% OFF". Smaller top line: "SPECIAL OFFER". Bottom call to action: "SHOP NOW". Stylish abstract orange circle and blue geometric details create energy without competing with text. Professional retail social post, clean and eye-catching, flat graphic design. Only these three text elements. No invented brand names, no dates, no coupon codes, no additional conditions or claims.
